import json, os, pathlib, subprocess, time, shutil, tempfile
svc='jellyfin-pink.service'
services=('vivoapk-backend.service',svc,'nginx.service','postgresql.service')
ff='/usr/bin/ffmpeg'
def run(args, timeout=10):
 try:
  p=subprocess.run(args,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=timeout)
  return p.returncode,p.stdout
 except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
  return 124,''
def health():
 return {s:run(['systemctl','is-active',s])[1].strip() for s in services}
def available():
 return next(int(l.split()[1])*1024 for l in pathlib.Path('/proc/meminfo').read_text().splitlines() if l.startswith('MemAvailable:'))
def prop(name):
 return run(['systemctl','show',svc,'-p',name,'--value'])[1].strip()
before=health()
cpus=os.cpu_count() or 1
mem=available()
load=os.getloadavg()[0]
disk=shutil.disk_usage('/srv/projects').free
limits={k:prop(k) for k in ('CPUQuotaPerSecUSec','MemoryHigh','MemoryMax','TasksMax','PrivateNetwork','User')}
result={'scope':'isolated 2x720p25 real-time synthetic FFmpeg HLS, outside production cgroup; no subscriber media, configuration changes, network load or service restart','cpu_count':cpus,'available_ram_before_bytes':mem,'disk_free_before_bytes':disk,'load_before':round(load,2),'services_before':before,'jellyfin_configured_limits':limits,'ffmpeg_version':run([ff,'-version'])[1].splitlines()[0]}
print(json.dumps({'preflight':result}),flush=True)
assert all(v=='active' for v in before.values()) and limits['User']=='jellyfinpink'
if cpus<4 or mem<1536*1024*1024 or disk<2*1024**3 or load>=cpus*0.5:
 result.update(status='skipped_resource_gate',services_after=health())
 print(json.dumps(result),flush=True)
 raise SystemExit(3)
jobs=[]
duration=36
page=os.sysconf('SC_PAGE_SIZE')
clk=os.sysconf('SC_CLK_TCK')
peak_cache=peak_rss=peak_cpu=0
min_mem=mem
peak_segments=[0,0]
old_removed=[False,False]
early=[set(),set()]
workdir=pathlib.Path('/srv/projects/skill-universal/.runtime')
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='vivoapk-synthetic-hls-',dir=workdir) as tmp:
 root=pathlib.Path(tmp)
 begin=time.monotonic()
 try:
  for i in range(2):
   folder=root/str(i)
   folder.mkdir(mode=0o700)
   progress=folder/'progress.txt'
   error=folder/'errors.txt'
   with progress.open('wb') as out,error.open('wb') as err:
    cmd=['nice','-n','10',ff,'-hide_banner','-nostdin','-v','error','-nostats','-progress','pipe:1','-filter_threads','1','-filter_complex_threads','1','-re','-f','lavfi','-i','testsrc2=size=1280x720:rate=25','-f','lavfi','-i',f'sine=frequency={440+110*i}:sample_rate=48000','-t',str(duration),'-c:v','libx264','-threads:v','1','-preset','veryfast','-pix_fmt','yuv420p','-b:v','2500k','-maxrate','2500k','-bufsize','5000k','-g','50','-keyint_min','50','-sc_threshold','0','-c:a','aac','-b:a','128k','-threads:a','1','-f','hls','-hls_time','2','-hls_list_size','5','-hls_delete_threshold','3','-hls_flags','delete_segments+omit_endlist','-hls_segment_filename',str(folder/'segment-%05d.ts'),str(folder/'index.m3u8')]
    jobs.append(subprocess.Popen(cmd,stdout=out,stderr=err))
  last_cpu=0
  last_at=begin
  last_health=begin
  both_running=0
  while any(p.poll() is None for p in jobs):
   now=time.monotonic()
   if now-begin>52: raise RuntimeError('bounded benchmark exceeded deadline')
   if all(p.poll() is None for p in jobs): both_running+=1
   current_mem=available()
   min_mem=min(min_mem,current_mem)
   if current_mem<768*1024*1024 or os.getloadavg()[0]>cpus*1.5:
    raise RuntimeError('resource safety threshold reached')
   rss=cpu=cache=0
   for i,p in enumerate(jobs):
    try:
     st=pathlib.Path(f'/proc/{p.pid}/stat').read_text().rsplit(') ',1)[1].split()
     cpu+=(int(st[11])+int(st[12]))/clk
     rss+=int(pathlib.Path(f'/proc/{p.pid}/statm').read_text().split()[1])*page
    except (OSError,IndexError,ValueError): pass
    segs=list((root/str(i)).glob('*.ts'))
    names={q.name for q in segs}
    if not early[i] and names: early[i]=set(names)
    if early[i] and names and not early[i]&names: old_removed[i]=True
    peak_segments[i]=max(peak_segments[i],len(names))
    for q in segs:
     try: cache+=q.stat().st_size
     except FileNotFoundError: pass
   peak_cache=max(peak_cache,cache)
   peak_rss=max(peak_rss,rss)
   if now-last_at>=1:
    peak_cpu=max(peak_cpu,max(0,(cpu-last_cpu)/(now-last_at)))
    last_cpu,last_at=cpu,now
   if cache>32*1024**2: raise RuntimeError('isolated synthetic cache bound exceeded')
   if now-last_health>=6:
    if health()!=before: raise RuntimeError('service health changed during benchmark')
    print(json.dumps({'sample_seconds':round(now-begin,1),'active_encoders':sum(p.poll() is None for p in jobs),'cache_bytes':cache,'ffmpeg_rss_bytes':rss}),flush=True)
    last_health=now
   time.sleep(0.5)
  wall=time.monotonic()-begin
  outcomes=[]
  for i,p in enumerate(jobs):
   folder=root/str(i)
   fields=dict(line.strip().split('=',1) for line in (folder/'progress.txt').read_text().splitlines() if '=' in line)
   frames=int(fields.get('frame','0').strip() or '0')
   segs=sorted(folder.glob('*.ts'))
   assert p.returncode==0 and frames>=duration*25-2 and fields.get('progress')=='end' and segs
   rc,decoded=run([ff,'-hide_banner','-nostdin','-v','error','-i',str(segs[-2] if len(segs)>1 else segs[-1]),'-map','0:v:0','-map','0:a:0','-f','framemd5','pipe:1'],timeout=8)
   v=sum(l.startswith('0,') for l in decoded.splitlines())
   a=sum(l.startswith('1,') for l in decoded.splitlines())
   assert rc==0 and min(v,a)>=10
   outcomes.append({'encoder':i+1,'frames':frames,'speed':fields.get('speed','').strip(),'video_frames_decoded':v,'audio_frames_decoded':a,'old_segments_removed':old_removed[i],'peak_segments':peak_segments[i]})
  result.update(status='completed',jobs=outcomes,wall_seconds=round(wall,2),peak_sampled_cache_bytes=peak_cache,peak_sampled_encoder_rss_bytes=peak_rss,peak_sampled_encoder_cpu_cores=round(peak_cpu,3),minimum_available_ram_bytes=min_mem,concurrent_samples=both_running,services_after=health())
  assert wall<=duration*1.15 and both_running>=40 and all(old_removed) and result['services_after']==before
 finally:
  for p in jobs:
   if p.poll() is None: p.terminate()
  for p in jobs:
   try: p.wait(timeout=3)
   except subprocess.TimeoutExpired: p.kill();p.wait(timeout=3)
result['temporary_directory_removed']=not root.exists()
assert result['temporary_directory_removed']
print(json.dumps(result),flush=True)
